tei:div.tei:p: 145) ༄༅/ rang gnas gnyug ma'i ye shes car phog tu ston pa'i// ka dag chos sku'i bla ma ngag gi ni dbang po// gsang chen dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbang bzhi yis smin mdzad// 'od gsal longs sku'i ston pa rgyal mtshan gyi 'od zer// bstan rtsa so sor thar la dang por ni 'jug mdzad// zung 'jug sprul sku'i gar sgyur chos kyi dang nyi ma// rgyal sras rigs gsum mgon dang rnam dbyer ni med pa'i// mtshungs med drin chen rnam gsum snying dbus su bzhugs dang*// chung nas rta kha thub nas dkor g.yog la brgyugs nas// bskyed rdzogs gang yang med pa'i grong chog ni mang pos// shi dge gson dkor mang po hab thob tu zos pa'i// don med ming gis mgo bskor sprul ming 'dis skyo byung*// na tshod cung zad lon dus gzab 'phyor dang rgyan spros// rang bstod gzhan la smad pa'i zur za dang khong khro// chags sdang nyon mongs skye bo tha mal las che yang*// thob thang 'dra mos gral mgor sdod pa 'dis skyo byung*// rang nyid nyes spyod sdom pa'i bca' bsgrigs ni ma phog 146) /gzhan skyon lta ba'i chu bur me lce las rno bas// bsgrigs lam grwa sar zhugs la bsnyad bsko dang btsan 'dzud// rgyag rdung lcags kyis brab sogs mgo dpon 'dis skyo byung*// yon tan re re mi ldan dge 'dun ni med pas// g.yog dang khol po 'u lag btsan thabs su ded nas// bla ma'i ming tsam thogs kyang chos min gyi bya ba// tshe gang btud mar dgos pa'i las ngan 'dis skyo byung*// rgyal ba'i bstan la phyogs med thos bsam ni byas kyang*// phyogs med mos gus ma skyes phyogs 'dzin gyi snon ma// gzhan phyogs 'drer mthong rang phyogs lha ltar du mthong ba'i// rang rgyud ma smin thos bsam byed mdog 'dis skyo byung*// bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la sbyang goms ni byas kyang*// ci tsam sbyangs kyang da dung ma shes pa grangs mang*// snga ma shes tshad da lta'i yid yul la mi 'dug

/mi brjed gzungs ma thob pa'i bslab gnyer 'dis skyo byung*// so byang sngags kyi sdom pa yod rgu ni blangs kyang*// gnang bkag dam tshig gtsang ma mi 'ong ni thag chod// lus ngag spyod pa tsam yang bab 'chol du shor song*// mgo bsdam 147) mjug lhod srung sdom byed mdog 'dis skyo byung*// gsar rnying rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ni zhus kyang*// rim gnyis rnal 'byor lag tu lon pa ni lta ci// snang srid lhar snang tsam yang yid yul du mi 'char// thog med btud mar gnod pa'i 'khrul 'dzin 'dis skyo byung*// rnam rtog lam du byed pa'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim// btang 'gro bzhag sdod lam longs sems gnas tsam med na// gsal brtan tshad brgyad thob pa'i gom 'dris ni lta ci// 'dzad med chu bo'i rgyun 'dra'i rnam rtog 'dis skyo byung*// gzhi gnas gnyug ma'i ye shes rang zhal ni mjal yang*// rnam rtog phra mo re res glo bur du bsgribs song*// da ni gar yin 'di yin ngo shes ni mi 'dug /rnam rtog gar skyes bzod pa'i nyams len 'dis skyo byung*// da ni byas tshad thams cad tshe 'di yi 'dun ma// dran tshad thams cad tha mal 'khrul pa yi rang bzhin// gang la bsam kyang skyo ba dbang med du skyes byung*// thams cad thams cad skyur shog byas pas ni mi zin// byar med ye bab rang gnas chos nyid kyi lhums su// mi rtog bsam ngo bral 148)bas gnyid yul la btang bzhag /bzhag pas bor rgyu mi 'dug lhan skyes kyi ye shes/ kho thag nang nas chod pa'i nges shes ni lhang lhang*// gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang bzhag gdod ma yi rgyal thabs// gang shar chos sku'i yo lang 'ba' zhig las mi 'dug /sgom dang ma sgom mnyam rjes tha dad ni ma mthong*// rnam rtog gang shar rig stong rjen pa yi rang zas// skye dang bskye mi 'dug chos nyid du shar shar// shar chas 'od gsal ma bu kha sbyor du bsres pas// 'khor yug 'od gsal gnyug ma'i rgyal thabs la chas 'gro// ring nas shes pa'i bla ma bde ba ni chen po// tshe 'dir sgrub pa'i rnam rtog gang shar ni thams cad// rang shar rang grol ngang du shar shar la thongs dang*// mi rtog gnyug ma'i ngang du rang bab la gnas yong*// pham lhag bcu bdun 'di la srog dmar dang bsdos la// bsrung sems brtan po'i dam bca' thugs dam gyi mthil mdzod// rnam rtog lang shor 'di yis 'di phyi kun phung bas// mnyam bzhag dus su shar grol dus mnyam la thong mdzod// rjes thob blo ldog rnam bzhi mar shes

149) dang drin dran// byams dang snying rje'i rang bzhin byang chub kyi sems mchog /skad cig tsam yang mi g.yol snying dbus su gzung mdzod// snang srid dpe char shar ba'i gdams ngag ni dran nas// gang byas chos su 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor la gzhol mdzod/
shing byi lo'i dgongs 'dus sgrub chen skabs pad nor pas bris/ dge'o// 150)
